newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EESTI KINDLUSTUS MAY PROFIT 1.9 MLN.
newsitem.headline: EESTI KINDLUSTUS MAY PROFIT 1.9 MLN.

text.p: The profit in May of Eesti Kindlustus, the insurance subsidiary of Hoiupank , was 1.9 million kroons leading to a current year profit of 11.2 million kroons, the company said on Wednesday.
The insurance company's balance sheet increased from the beginning of the year by 25 percent to 161.7 million kroons and shareholders' equity rose to 50.9 million kroons.
Eesti varakindlustus, the part of Eesti kindlustus that does property insurance, had a May profit of 4.4 million kroons and for the first five months total profit was 15.4 million kroons.
The Eesti varakindlustus balance sheet volume grew to 137.6 million kroons and at the same time shareholders' equity increased to 73.6 million kroons.
